_meta.what: Pre-existing `tsc --noEmit` errors, frozen. `npm run typecheck` fails on anything not counted here.
_meta.why: next.config.mjs sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors:true (gotcha #10), so type errors have deployed green for the life of the project. A clean gate today would red every push until all of these are cleared, and a step that reds every push gets `|| true`-d. Freezing the known count makes the gate holdable now instead of aspirational later.
_meta.ratchet: Both directions. Fixing errors without lowering this file also fails — a baseline above the real count is headroom new debt can be added into unnoticed.
_meta.note: 4,491 of the 4,612 errors that existed before L2-234 were missing jest globals; declaring @types/jest@30.0.0 removed them. What remains is real.
